item.title: Teen biked 700 miles with injured dad; where is she now?
item.description: Her ride carrying her injured father on a $20 hot pink bicycle drew headlines. Promises of financial help and cycling career training followed.

item.title: Hurricane Simon approaches Mexico with 155 mph winds
item.description: The eye of Hurricane Simon was off Mexico's Pacific coast early Sunday and was expected to move inland later as an extremely powerful storm.

item.title: Fear can be fun and possibly useful, expert says
item.description: NPR host Ayesha Rascoe enjoys horror. A look at why fans of the genre find fear entertaining and potentially beneficial.

item.title: Justice Department investigates TV networks over possible antitrust violations
item.description: The action intensifies Trump's conflict with the press amid a court dispute over excluding CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.
